references.text: All his sons and all his daughters tried to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted. "No," he said, "I will go down to my son in the realm of the dead in mourning." So his father wept for him.

But he said: "My son shall not go down with you. His brother is dead, and he is the only one left. If harm should befall him on the journey you are about to take, you would send my gray head down to the realm of the dead in sorrow."
If you now take this one away from me too, and harm comes to him, you will send my gray head down to the realm of the dead in sorrow.
When he sees that the boy is not there, he will die. Your servants will bring our father's gray head down to the realm of the dead in sorrow.
Rachel giving birth to Benjamin and her death – Benjamin as Rachel's son and Joseph's brother, the special bond between them as Jacob's sons with Rachel.
Direct narrative continuation showing the consequence of not sending Benjamin along.
